text: Football serves as a premier platform for youth development, yet gender-based participation gaps remain a persistent challenge within the global sporting landscape. Drawing on Ecological Systems Theory as a conceptual framework, this study utilized psychological network analysis to examine selected psychosocial factors related to football participation among primary school students.
source_label: Psychosocial correlates of children’s football participation: a psychological network analysis of parental support, stereotypes, and dualistic passions
